cta.cta_text: Talk through your questions with an Edstellar assessment specialist.

items.question: What is a pre-employment assessment?
items.answer: A pre-employment assessment, also called a pre-hire assessment, pre-employment test or pre-employment testing, is a structured way to measure candidates’ potential, judgment, behaviors and fit for a role before an offer is made. It brings consistent evidence into recruitment alongside interviews and CVs.

items.question: Which pre-employment assessment tools does Edstellar use?
items.answer: Edstellar selects from tools including Talogy Spotlight, Talogy I-Grade, Capture, Talogy Hire, Dilemmas Series, CBI Smart and Safety DNA. Each tool is chosen for the role, the hiring route and the hiring volume.

items.question: What is a situational judgment test?
items.answer: A situational judgment test presents realistic work scenarios and asks candidates how they would respond. It shows job-relevant judgment and behavioral fit, and works well as an early screen alongside cognitive or skills tests and structured interviews.

items.question: Can pre-employment assessments handle high-volume hiring?
items.answer: Yes. Short, mobile-friendly online screening assessments make candidate assessment for large applicant pools quick and consistent, with ranked shortlists for each role, so recruiters focus their time on the strongest candidates.

items.question: How does Edstellar support campus hiring?
items.answer: For graduate, intern and early-career hiring, Edstellar uses early-careers assessments such as Talogy Spotlight alongside situational judgment tests, structured interviews and realistic job previews, so campus recruitment identifies potential rather than experience alone.

items.question: Are pre-employment tests fair to all candidates?
items.answer: Edstellar uses tools with published reliability and validity evidence, standardized administration and structured interviews, monitors pass rates across candidate groups, and aligns every process with local hiring rules. This reduces bias and gives every candidate the same opportunity.

items.question: How do pre-employment assessments affect the candidate experience?
items.answer: Well-designed assessments improve it. Short, mobile-friendly tests, clear instructions and realistic job previews help candidates understand the role and show their best, and give them a fair, consistent process.

items.question: How long does it take to set up pre-employment testing?
items.answer: A typical program is ready to launch in about six weeks, from job analysis to configured tools, interview guides and decision rules. Most candidates complete their online assessments in a single sitting.

items.question: Can Edstellar assess candidates for safety-critical roles?
items.answer: Yes. For manufacturing, oil and gas, logistics and other safety-critical roles, Edstellar uses Safety DNA and Talogy I-Grade to assess safety attitudes, reliability and risk behavior before the offer.

items.question: How is candidate data protected?
items.answer: Candidate data is collected only for the agreed hiring purpose, access is limited to agreed stakeholders, and results are reported under the confidentiality terms set at scoping. Edstellar holds ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification for information security management.

items.question: How much does a pre-employment assessment cost?
items.answer: Cost depends on the number of roles and candidates, the tools chosen, whether structured interview design and training are included, and how much reporting you need. Edstellar scopes each program before quoting, so you pay only for what your hiring requires.
